page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c9ae.16xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 64 dedicated vCPUs utilizing AMD EPYC 9T95 processors running at a clock speed of 2.25 GHz. The instance is configured with 128.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 2.0 GB of RAM per vCPU.

This server type does not include any local storage, requiring external block storage volumes for operating system and data storage needs. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 32 Gbps. No complimentary public IPv4 addresses are bundled with the instance. The lack of local storage and the low RAM-to-vCPU ratio represent key architectural tradeoffs, prioritizing raw compute density over memory capacity or local disk performance.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated AMD EPYC processor allocation provides predictable compute resources without the overhead of shared-core models. The 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio makes this instance profile suitable for compute-heavy workloads that do not require massive memory footprints or local NVMe storage. Appropriate workloads include batch processing, web serving, distributed analytics, and compute-intensive microservices.
